picks.what: The oil refineries from the southeast, lantern slide (ETH Library, Zurich)
picks.why: only true general view; refinery chimneys and smoke on the skyline, the city’s defining industry; trimmed slide frame, handwritten caption and some empty field

gaps: P0–P3: nothing; P4: only 1877 war illustrations (troops parading, a market by the Russian headquarters) and an 1882 street plan, skipped
notes: The 1935 view is modest (mostly a field with the refinery skyline); drop it if a stronger P5 view turns up. The 1936 slide is a single oil fire seen from a train, and the 1943–44 pictures are bombing raids.
